reason: All four pins and eight quotations match. Q1 states the exact capture and post-checkout receipt triggers, prebuilt/custom and regional qualifications. Q2 correctly describes the unchanged Terminal behavior and separately dated general guidance, except that 'Dashboard-only' claims exclusivity that the Terminal captures do not establish.
required_changes: Change actual Q2's 'Dashboard-only test handling' to the exact dated rule already stated in Q1: Stripe does not automatically send Terminal receipts for test API key payments, and operators can view or manually send them in the Dashboard (old raw line 8 and new raw line 9). Both guides give an available Dashboard route, without excluding other receipt access surfaces. The separately dated general guide discusses receipt URLs at raw/stripe-receipts-2026-11-07.md:65-67, so the unqualified exclusivity would mislead a reader asking whether application access is ruled out. Keep the general guide scoped separately and avoid asserting that a test Terminal receipt URL is guaranteed.

source_assessment_decisions.reason: The raw reference disposition and dated summary corrections are supported. Narrow the actual Q2 test-key handling to the documented automatic-send limitation and Dashboard action.
